ledger.x: 1721: Kexholm County ends; the page's governors run from Henrik Månsson (1634-1636) to Berendt Mellin (1674-1690), later governors not listed.

wars.name: Ingrian War
wars.outcome: The Treaty of Stolbovo (9 March 1617, O.S.

wars.name: Great Northern War
wars.outcome: The Treaty of Nystad (30 August 1721) ceded the southern and eastern parts of Kexholm County to Russia; the rest was reorganised as Kymmenegård and Nyslott County.

certainty.note: The county's parishes are named only at the northern and eastern ends; the polygon is a rough fit and the rest is the researcher's.
